static: harsh analog VHS tape static, loud white noise hiss with crackle and a low hum, a tape ending on a blank channel
glitch: a very short VHS tape tracking glitch: a warbling distorted electrical crackle and a brief buzz
tape_hiss: constant soft analog videotape hiss and faint mechanical motor whir, steady, loopable
breath_bed: a frightened man breathing shakily and quietly right next to a camcorder microphone, uneven breaths, trying to stay quiet, loopable
step: one single footstep of a work boot on a hard polished stone floor in a large empty hall, close, with a short echo
camclick: a 1990s camcorder record button pressed: a plastic click and the tape transport motor starting up
handling: a camcorder microphone rubbed and knocked by a hand as the camera is spun around fast
mall_hum: an empty shopping mall at night, low steady air conditioning drone and faint fluorescent light buzz, distant, loopable
fluor_hum: an empty tiled corridor at night: a buzzing fluorescent light that flickers now and then, ventilation hum, no people, loopable
tube_tick: a single sharp electrical tick of a flickering fluorescent tube, one click with a tiny buzz, dry
tube_pop: a fluorescent tube dying: a sharp electrical pop and its buzz cutting off into silence
near_breath: slow, deep, calm breathing of someone standing right against a microphone, very close and intimate, long inhales and exhales, unhurried, not scared, no voice, loopable
minilab: a 1990s one-hour photo minilab machine running in a closed shop at night: a steady electric motor hum, paper rollers turning and soft rhythmic mechanical clicks, no voices, no music, loopable
print_drop: a photo printing machine pushing out one glossy photo print: a short motorized roller whir, then the print sliding out and dropping into a plastic tray with a light papery slap, close
print_flip: a thumb sliding one glossy photo print off a small stack: a quick dry paper slide and a soft slap, very close, quiet room
flash_charge: an old camera flash charging up: a thin high-pitched electronic whine rising steadily in pitch for three seconds, close behind the listener, in a silent dark room, no other sound
flash_pop: a camera shutter clack and the sharp loud pop of a big camera flash firing right behind the listener, a hard electric crack, then silence
shutter_far: a single quiet mechanical camera shutter click and a short film advance ratchet from a few metres away in a silent dark room, no flash
breath: one slow quiet human exhale very close to a microphone, muffled, no voice
vcr_clunk: a 1990s VCR jog shuttle control: one hard mechanical clunk and a quick whir of the tape heads
